dimensions.evidenceA: The mission begins with divine speech to Moses.
dimensions.evidenceB: The mission proposal begins with the people and Moses’ approval.
dimensions.label: Initiating agency

evidence.observation: The LORD tells Moses to send men to spy out Canaan, and Moses sends them according to the LORD’s command.
Moses recalls that the people came near and proposed sending men, and that the proposal pleased him.

record.tension: Numbers and Deuteronomy identify different initiating agents without supplying the sequence that relates divine instruction, popular proposal, and Moses’ approval.
record.title: Who initiates the spying mission?
